title: Record a lab order
summary: Enter a job for the lab step by step: patient, services with teeth, laboratory and review; it can be sent while creating it.

inputs.send_due_date: Expected delivery date if sent now (YYYY-MM-DD)

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Patient
steps.details: Who the job is for. From the patient record it is already selected.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: Who requested the job; the order’s alerts go to them.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Moves on to the job. If the patient is missing, it is marked in red.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: Pick the job from the lab services list. You can add several; if it does not exist, create it from here.

steps.title: Teeth
steps.details: The teeth for that service: type them or tap them on the chart next to it. The order’s teeth are all its services’ teeth combined.

steps.title: Service note
steps.details: Shade, material or any instruction for the lab.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Moves on to the laboratory. At least one service or a job description is needed.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: Optional for now: if you leave it empty, it is asked for when the order is sent. Below are the laboratories of the services’ category to pick with one tap.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Moves on to review the order before creating it.

steps.title: Review the order
steps.details: Patient, job and laboratory. “Edit” goes back to that step without losing what you entered.

steps.title: Send it now?
steps.details: “Save it to send later” leaves it in the initial stage. “Send it now” creates it and moves it to the next stage: it asks for the laboratory and the expected delivery date.

steps.title: Expected delivery
steps.details: The date the laboratory promised; from the next day the order shows as overdue.

steps.title: Attachments
steps.details: Photos, PDFs or 3D scans for the lab; they are uploaded when the order is created.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.details: If you turn it on, it comes first in the list, on the board and in the patient file.

steps.title: Create the order
steps.details: If not sent, it enters the initial stage with no delivery date. With “Send it now”, it lands in the next stage with the laboratory and the date.
